title: The task
body: Find the highest temperature in **[3, -2, 9, 4]**. We will read the list once and keep one variable, `best`.

title: Handle the empty list
body: The list has values, so we can start. If it were empty, we would return null right away instead of reading `temps[0]`.

title: Start from the first value
body: Set `best = 3`. Starting from the first element, not from 0, keeps the answer right when every temperature is negative.

title: Visit -2
body: -2 is not bigger than 3, so `best` stays 3. One comparison, no extra memory.

title: Visit 4 and finish
body: 4 is not bigger than 9. The loop ends and we return **9**. We did one comparison per element: **O(n) time**, and kept one variable: **O(1) space**.
